notes: Openspec provided empty ACs, so all criteria were derived from the story description and technical file hints. AC-1 covers the core 'real-time preview without full reload' promise. AC-2 through AC-4 ensure multi-market (GO/UP/MX) coverage. AC-5 and AC-6 address connection interruption and recovery edge cases. AC-7 ensures preview survives client-side navigation. AC-8 and AC-9 cover specific content types mentioned in the technical notes (contentCard, ContentstackLink). AC-10 ensures no performance or behavioral regression in production mode. AC-11 addresses concurrent edit scenarios. AC-12 addresses the security/boundary concern that preview content must not leak to production users. AC-13 covers accessibility preservation. AC-14 covers referenced/linked content updates.
